title: Building multi-agent systems: when and how to use them
tldr: This post provides architectural considerations and strategic use cases for developing multi-agent AI systems. It outlines best practices for agent collaboration, task decomposition, and designing robust, modular agentic workflows with effective inter-agent communication protocols.

title: Building agents with Skills: Equipping agents for specialized work
tldr: Anthropic details a framework for endowing AI agents with specialized 'skills' to tackle complex, domain-specific tasks. The methodology covers skill definition, seamless integration, and execution, enhancing agent autonomy and performance through modular development.

title: Extending Claude’s capabilities with skills and MCP servers
tldr: This engineering blog explores advanced techniques for expanding Claude's capabilities using custom 'skills' and a new MCP (Multi-Context Processing) server architecture. It focuses on distributed execution and robust context management, enabling more scalable and specialized agentic workflows for complex tasks.

title: Customize AI agent browsing with proxies, profiles, and extensions in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser
tldr: AWS introduces enhanced customization features for AI agent browsing within Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser, allowing developers to configure proxies, distinct profiles, and extensions. This provides granular control over agent interaction with web environments, crucial for sophisticated information gathering, targeted data extraction, and secure task execution.

title: GPT-5.2 derives a new result in theoretical physics
tldr: OpenAI's GPT-5.2 model has successfully derived a novel result in theoretical physics, showcasing advanced reasoning and discovery capabilities. This demonstrates a significant step towards AI-driven scientific breakthroughs, potentially accelerating fundamental research.

title: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT
tldr: OpenAI introduces 'Lockdown Mode' and 'Elevated Risk' labels for ChatGPT, enhancing safety protocols and user control over potentially sensitive interactions. These features represent technical advancements in model governance and responsible AI deployment.

title: Beyond rate limits: scaling access to Codex and Sora
tldr: OpenAI details new infrastructure and engineering strategies to scale access for Codex and Sora, moving beyond traditional rate limits. This signifies advancements in high-throughput, low-latency serving for large generative models.

title: Scaling social science research
tldr: OpenAI is exploring methods to scale social science research using AI, likely involving new computational tools or frameworks for data analysis and simulation. This initiative aims to enhance the scope and efficiency of social inquiry through advanced AI application.

title: On Agent Frameworks and Agent Observability
tldr: LangChain provides a comprehensive analysis of modern agent frameworks and underscores the critical importance of agent observability for developing reliable AI systems. It outlines essential metrics and tooling for monitoring agent behavior, tool utilization, and decision-making processes, ensuring transparency and efficient debugging in complex autonomous systems.

title: Custom Kernels for All from Codex and Claude
tldr: Hugging Face demonstrates the automated generation of custom CUDA kernels facilitated by advanced LLMs like Codex and Claude, significantly boosting performance for specialized AI tasks. This technique empowers developers to create highly optimized, low-level operations without extensive CUDA programming expertise, streamlining performance tuning for agentic applications.

title: Build long-running MCP servers on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with Strands Agents integration
tldr: AWS details the construction of long-running Multi-Context Processing (MCP) servers on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, enabling persistent agent states and complex, multi-stage operations. This infrastructure facilitates advanced agentic workflows through seamless integration with Strands Agents, supporting continuous task execution and robust memory management.

title: Gemini 3 Deep Think: Advancing science, research and engineering
tldr: DeepMind introduces Gemini 3 Deep Think, a significant new foundation model specifically engineered to accelerate scientific discovery, complex research, and advanced engineering problems. The model showcases dramatically enhanced reasoning capabilities and expanded knowledge integration across diverse technical domains, promising breakthroughs in various fields.

title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
tldr: OpenAI has announced GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, a new iteration of their language model likely specializing in code generation and optimized for specific computational tasks. This represents a significant advancement in their model lineup, particularly for developer tools and agentic workflows.

title: OpenEnv in Practice: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents in Real-World Environments
tldr: Hugging Face introduces OpenEnv, a robust framework for rigorously evaluating tool-using AI agents within realistic, complex environments, addressing the limitations of static benchmarks. This platform allows researchers to assess agent robustness, adaptability, and sophisticated decision-making in interactive, real-world-like scenarios.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B MoE model is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
tldr: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Nano 30B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model is now available through Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, significantly democratizing access to this performant and efficient large language model. This integration provides developers with streamlined deployment for leveraging a state-of-the-art MoE architecture across various downstream AI tasks.

title: The Death of Traditional Testing: Agentic Development Broke a 50-Year-Old Field, JiTTesting Can Revive It
tldr: Meta AI explores how the emergence of agentic AI development disrupts traditional software testing paradigms, highlighting the inadequacy of static tests for dynamic agent behaviors. The blog introduces JiTTesting (Just-in-Time Testing) as a novel methodology to dynamically validate complex agent interactions and ensure the reliability of evolving AI systems.

title: Harness engineering: leveraging Codex in an agent-first world
tldr: OpenAI's 'Harness Engineering' blog discusses technical strategies for integrating and leveraging their Codex models within an agent-first paradigm. This covers methodologies and best practices for developing robust and effective AI agents using advanced code generation capabilities.

title: R²D²: Scaling Multimodal Robot Learning with NVIDIA Isaac Lab
tldr: This post introduces R²D², a novel framework leveraging NVIDIA Isaac Lab to scale multimodal robot learning by addressing challenges in data collection, simulation, and real-world transfer. It details how the approach enables robots to learn complex tasks from diverse sensory inputs, accelerating the development of robust robotic agents.

title: Building real-time voice assistants with Amazon Nova Sonic compared to cascading architectures
tldr: AWS introduces Amazon Nova Sonic as a novel, highly efficient architecture for building real-time voice assistants, contrasting its performance and latency advantages against traditional cascading models. The post details the technical innovations enabling Nova Sonic to achieve superior responsiveness and natural conversational flow for interactive AI applications.

title: Using Accelerated Computing to Live-Steer Scientific Experiments at Massive Research Facilities
tldr: This article explores the application of accelerated computing, particularly GPUs, to enable real-time steering and optimization of complex scientific experiments conducted at large-scale research facilities. It describes how this paradigm shift allows researchers to adapt experiment parameters dynamically, leading to more efficient data collection and discovery by integrating AI-driven feedback loops.

title: The two patterns by which agents connect sandboxes
tldr: This article discusses two primary architectural patterns (sidecar vs. direct) for integrating AI agents with isolated execution environments (sandboxes) to enhance security and controlled tool use. It details the tradeoffs and implementation considerations for each approach, offering guidance on building robust and safe agentic systems.

title: Automated Reasoning checks rewriting chatbot reference implementation
tldr: AWS outlines a methodology for applying automated reasoning checks to rewrite chatbot reference implementations, significantly enhancing their logical consistency and safety. This technical approach aims to formally verify the behavior of conversational AI systems, crucial for preventing unintended responses and ensuring robust reliability in production.

title: Automating Inference Optimizations with NVIDIA TensorRT LLM AutoDeploy
tldr: This post introduces NVIDIA TensorRT LLM AutoDeploy, a new tool designed to automate the complex process of optimizing large language model inference for deployment on NVIDIA GPUs. It details how AutoDeploy streamlines quantization, kernel selection, and graph optimization, significantly reducing the manual effort required to achieve peak LLM performance.

title: Building Prometheus: How Backend Aggregation Enables Gigawatt-Scale AI Clusters
tldr: Meta's engineering team details the architecture of "Prometheus," a custom backend aggregation system engineered to enable gigawatt-scale AI clusters. This infrastructure innovation addresses critical challenges in power delivery, data throughput, and thermal management, essential for supporting the immense computational demands of next-generation large-scale AI models.

title: Scale LLM fine-tuning with Hugging Face and Amazon SageMaker AI
tldr: AWS details a scalable architecture for LLM fine-tuning using Hugging Face libraries on Amazon SageMaker AI, addressing significant computational and data challenges. The guide provides best practices for distributed training, efficient resource allocation, and optimizing the fine-tuning process to effectively scale large language models for various downstream tasks.

title: Accelerate agentic application development with a full-stack starter template for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
tldr: AWS introduces a comprehensive full-stack starter template for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, designed to significantly accelerate the development of complex agentic applications. This template provides a foundational architecture and best practices for seamlessly integrating large language models with external tools and services, streamlining agent deployment workflows.

title: Accelerating Mathematical and Scientific Discovery with Gemini Deep Think
tldr: This DeepMind publication elaborates on the technical application of Gemini Deep Think for accelerating mathematical and scientific research. It highlights the model's novel computational approaches to problem-solving, hypothesis generation, and theoretical exploration, demonstrating its capacity to significantly advance interdisciplinary scientific endeavors.

title: Agent-to-agent collaboration: Using Amazon Nova 2 Lite and Amazon Nova Act for multi-agent systems
tldr: AWS delves into advanced agent-to-agent collaboration strategies utilizing Amazon Nova 2 Lite and Nova Act models, specifically tailored for designing robust multi-agent systems. The post elaborates on communication protocols and sophisticated task delegation mechanisms, ultimately enhancing the collective intelligence and complex problem-solving capabilities of AI agent teams.

title: Transformers.js v4 Preview: Now Available on NPM!
tldr: Hugging Face announces the v4 preview of Transformers.js, extending advanced transformer model capabilities directly to JavaScript environments via NPM. This release enables efficient client-side and Node.js inference, significantly lowering the barrier for integrating powerful AI models into web applications and edge computing devices.
